section.content: 本实用新型提供一种锂离子电池，包括由带正极耳的正极、隔离膜和带负极耳的负极通过叠片和/或卷绕形成的裸电芯、封装所述裸电芯的壳体以及粘贴在所述裸电芯和所述壳体之间的热熔双面胶；所述热熔双面胶的粘贴面积为所述裸电芯被粘贴面的面积的60～90％，所述热熔双面胶上还设置有若干排气孔。相比于现有技术，本实用新型通过增大热熔双面胶的面积，利用大面积来增强裸电芯与壳体之间的粘结力，同时分散集中应力，保证了在定向跌落时不会因为电池的重力冲击而导致裸电芯与壳体粘结处的应力过大而撕裂壳体，解决了大容量电芯因贴胶面积小而导致撕裂裸电芯保护层的问题；另外，通过设置有多个排气孔，导出因贴胶面积过大而产生的气泡。

The utility model provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a naked battery cell formed by an anode with an anode lug, an isolating membrane and a cathode with a cathode lug through lamination and/or winding, a shell for packaging the naked battery cell and a hot melt double faced adhesive tape adhered between the naked battery cell and the shell; the sticking area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape does naked electric core is by 60 ~ 90% of the area of sticking the face, still be provided with a plurality of exhaust holes on the hot melt double faced adhesive tape. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses an increase the area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape, utilize the large tracts of land to strengthen the cohesive force between naked electric core and the casing, disperse the concentrated stress simultaneously, guaranteed that can not lead to because of the gravity impact of battery when the orientation falls that the stress of naked electric core and casing bonding department is too big tears the casing, solved the problem that the large capacity electric core leads to tearing naked electric core protective layer because the rubberizing area is little; in addition, the air bubbles generated due to the overlarge adhesive area are led out by arranging a plurality of air exhaust holes.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a technical field, concretely relates to lithium ion battery are made to lithium ion battery.

Background

With the common application of polymer lithium ion batteries in daily life, for example, a series of electronic products such as notebook computers, mobile phones and charge pal have the problem of fire and explosion caused by careless falling in the using process, so that the falling prevention of the batteries is a very core index for evaluating the safety performance of the lithium ion batteries. Paste the hot melt double faced adhesive tape between naked electric core and battery plastic-aluminum membrane, can fix the position of naked electric core between the plastic-aluminum membrane, prevent naked electric core drunkenness in the plastic-aluminum membrane at drop test in-process, the aggravation diaphragm turns over a book, and leads to the risk of electric core short circuit, the viscosity direct influence of hot melt double faced adhesive tape falls the throughput rate of test and the security performance of battery.

The current process route of the digital 3C battery is as follows: stirring → coating → cold pressing → splitting → winding → top side sealing → vacuum baking → liquid injection → normal temperature standing for 12 hours, high temperature standing for 16 hours → pressure formation → secondary sealing → folding → capacity grading → detection. When the pressure is formed, the protective layer surface of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive and the adhesive layer are mutually dissolved to generate viscosity under the conditions that the surface pressure is 1.0MPa and the temperature is 80 ℃, so that the aluminum plastic film is adhered to the bare cell.

Wherein, the hot melt double faced adhesive tape rubberizes after the coiling process is accomplished, and the viscidity face of hot melt adhesive pastes on the aluminium foil on naked electric core surface, before top side seal, and naked electric core circulation need be used the plastic uptake box, for preventing that naked electric core and plastic uptake box from gluing and causing the defective products together, so the protection aspect can not have viscidity. When the pressure becomes, the protective layer face is because under the condition that has pressure and temperature, and the protective layer produces viscidity with the glue film is mutually soluble to make naked electric core and plastic-aluminum membrane bond together, realize fixed position's effect.

With the development of the era, the long endurance capacity of the mobile phone becomes the mainstream requirement of the era, and the battery capacity of the traditional mobile phone is basically increased from 3000mAh to 5000 mAh. As the capacity of the battery is increased, the weight of the traditional battery with the capacity of 3000mAh is about 35g, and the weight of the battery with the capacity of 5000mAh reaches 65 g. The heavier the battery, the greater the safety risk of its falling.

At present, the following design difficulties exist for the electrical core adhesive with large capacity of 5000mAh and the like: 1) when a 5000mAh large battery cell is only pasted with 1-2 hot-melt double-sided adhesive tapes, in the process of a directional drop test, the bare battery cell and an aluminum plastic film can generate relative displacement due to gravity impact of the bare battery cell, and a hot melt adhesive adhered between the bare battery cell and the aluminum plastic film belongs to a stress release concentrated area, so that the problem that the surface protective layer of the bare battery cell is often torn is caused; once the tearing occurs, the torn hot melt adhesive can not fix the positions of the bare cell and the aluminum-plastic film, so that the subsequent anti-drop failure is caused; 2) if the area of the hot melt adhesive is directly increased, the thickness of the hot melt double-sided adhesive tape is too thin and is basically between 20 and 50 mu m, the problem of large bubbles exists during the gluing process, and unacceptable appearance defective products are generated.

In view of the above, it is necessary to provide a technical solution to the above problems.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to provide a: the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, solve large capacity electric core and lead to tearing naked electric core protective layer or because of the big problem that produces the bubble of rubberizing area because of the rubberizing area is little.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

a lithium ion battery comprises a naked battery cell formed by laminating and/or winding a positive electrode with a positive electrode lug, an isolating membrane and a negative electrode with a negative electrode lug, a shell for packaging the naked battery cell and a hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape adhered between the naked battery cell and the shell; the sticking area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape does naked electric core is by 60 ~ 90% of the area of sticking the face, the hot melt double faced adhesive tape is provided with the recess, the recess is located anodal ear and/or the below of negative pole ear, still be provided with a plurality of exhaust holes on the hot melt double faced adhesive tape.

The utility model provides a lithium ion battery with hot melt double faced adhesive tape, set up the area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape into naked electric core 60 ~ 90% of the area of being pasted the face, the hot melt double faced adhesive tape of utilization large tracts of land is pasted naked electric core and casing and is fixed together, strengthen the cohesive force between naked electric core and the casing, the concentrated stress has been disperseed in the bonding of while large tracts of land, guaranteed can not lead to naked electric core and the too big casing of tearing of stress of casing junction because of the gravity impact of battery when the orientation falls, the problem of tearing naked electric core protective layer because of the rubberizing area is little to have been solved to large capacity electric core. Meanwhile, a groove is formed in one end, close to the lug, of the hot-melt double-faced adhesive tape, and the arrangement of the groove avoids a lug area, so that the thickness of the lithium ion battery is not increased due to the overlapping of the hot-melt double-faced adhesive tape and the lug, and the risk of reducing the energy density is ingeniously avoided; in addition, a plurality of exhaust holes are formed in the hot melt double-sided adhesive, and bubbles which are easy to generate due to overlarge adhesive area can be exhausted through the exhaust holes, so that the problem of bubbles generated due to overlarge adhesive area is solved, and the tidiness of the appearance of the lithium ion battery is ensured.

Preferably, the adhering area of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is 68-82% of the area of the adhered surface of the bare cell. The area control with hot melt double faced adhesive tape can guarantee that the area of rubberizing is enough big in this within range, falls the in-process in the battery orientation, can not lead to tearing the casing because of naked electric core and casing bonding department are too big because of stress to promote the performance of falling of electric core. If the area of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is too small, the adhesive force of the double-sided adhesive tape cannot support the gravity impact caused by the weight of a high-capacity battery during a directional drop test, the bare cell is very easy to generate relative displacement with the shell, the adhered double-sided adhesive tape just serves as a concentrated stress release area, the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape becomes an important factor for tearing the shell, and the original significance of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is lost. Therefore, the sticking area of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is set to be better than 68-82% of the area of the stuck surface of the bare cell. The specific setting area can set the suitable sticking area according to the specific shape of naked electric core.

Preferably, the hot melt double faced adhesive tape is further provided with a groove, and the groove is formed in one end, close to the positive tab and the negative tab, of the hot melt double faced adhesive tape.

Preferably, the groove is arranged around the positive lug and matched with the positive lug. Set up recess and anodal ear phase-match for anodal ear's lower extreme can hold among the recess, and not only can further increase the rubberizing area and also avoided anodal ear region simultaneously, avoid hot melt double faced adhesive tape and anodal ear to overlap and produce the risk that reduces energy density.

Preferably, the groove is arranged around the negative electrode tab and matched with the negative electrode tab. Set up recess and negative pole ear phase-match for the lower extreme of negative pole ear can hold among the recess, and not only can further increase the rubberizing area and also avoided the negative pole ear region simultaneously, avoid hot melt double faced adhesive tape and negative pole ear to overlap and produce the risk that reduces energy density.

Preferably, the groove is disposed around the positive tab and the negative tab to surround the positive tab and the negative tab at the same time. Set up the recess in the below of anodal ear and negative pole ear and surround anodal ear and negative pole ear, can make the lower extreme of anodal ear and negative pole ear all hold among the recess, avoided utmost point ear region, avoid hot melt double faced adhesive tape and utmost point ear to overlap and produce the risk that reduces energy density.

Preferably, the groove comprises a first groove and a second groove, the first groove surrounds the positive tab and is matched with the positive tab, and the second groove surrounds the negative tab and is matched with the negative tab. The two grooves are respectively matched with the positive electrode lug and the negative electrode lug, the blank area between the two electrode lugs is also provided with the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape, the adhesive tape area is increased to a greater degree, the situation that the shell body bonded nearby the electrode lug is not torn is ensured, the electrode lug area is avoided simultaneously, and therefore the double-sided adhesive tape and the electrode lug are prevented from being overlapped to increase the thickness of the battery, and the energy density of the battery is reduced.

Preferably, the height of the adhesive tape of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is smaller than the height of the bare cell.

Preferably, the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape comprises a protective layer, a first adhesive layer, a base material layer and a second adhesive layer which are sequentially arranged.

Preferably, the protective layer is a styrene-isoprene polymer layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are both hydrogenated styrene-isoprene polymer layers, and the base material layer is a PET layer.

Preferably, the thickness of the protective layer is 2-4 μm, the thickness of the first adhesive layer and the thickness of the second adhesive layer are both 10-18 μm, and the thickness of the base material layer is 10-15 μm.

The utility model discloses a hot melt double faced adhesive tape adopts the design of four layers, utilizes the inviscid of styrene-isoprene polymer as the protective layer, and the rethread temperature regulation makes the styrene-isoprene polymer and the hydrogenated styrene-isoprene polymer of the same kind substance fuse and produces viscidity, and then realizes the adhesion of naked electric core and casing. And the thickness of this hot melt double faced adhesive tape maintains between 32 ~ 55 mu m, and this thickness can guarantee that the hot melt double faced adhesive tape can not too thick influence the whole thickness of battery, also can not too thin and be unfavorable for bonding, influence industrial practicality.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses following beneficial effect has at least:

1) the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a naked battery cell formed by an anode with an anode lug, an isolating membrane and a cathode with a cathode lug through lamination and/or winding, a shell for packaging the naked battery cell and a hot melt double faced adhesive tape adhered between the naked battery cell and the shell; the sticking area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape does naked electric core is by 60 ~ 90% of the area of sticking the face, still be provided with a plurality of exhaust holes on the hot melt double faced adhesive tape. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a set up the area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape into naked electric core by the 60 ~ 90% of the area of pasting the face, utilize the hot melt double faced adhesive tape of large tracts of land to paste naked electric core and casing together fixed, strengthen the cohesive force between naked electric core and the casing, the bonding of while large tracts of land has dispersed concentrated stress, guaranteed can not lead to naked electric core and the too big casing that tears of stress of casing bonding department because of the gravity impact of battery when the orientation falls, solved large capacity electric core and leaded to tearing the problem of naked electric core protective layer because of the rubberizing area is little. In addition, a plurality of vent holes are arranged on the hot melt double-faced adhesive tape, and air bubbles generated due to overlarge adhesive tape sticking area are led out by the vent holes.

2) The utility model discloses still be provided with the recess, set up the recess through the below at utmost point ear, avoided utmost point ear region when the bonding area of increase hot melt double faced adhesive tape, avoided the hot melt double faced adhesive tape and utmost point ear overlap the thickness that increases the battery and influence the energy density's of battery problem.

3) The utility model discloses simple structure is applicable to the mass production of industry.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical solutions and advantages of the present invention clearer, the present invention and its advantageous effects will be described in further detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings of the detailed description and the specification, but the present invention is not limited thereto.

Example 1

As shown in fig. 1, a lithium ion battery includes a bare cell 1 formed by laminating and/or winding a positive electrode with a positive tab 11, an isolation film, and a negative electrode with a negative tab 12, a case 2 encapsulating the bare cell 1, and a hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 adhered between the bare cell 1 and the case 2, wherein the positive tab 11 and the negative tab 12 both extend out of the case 2; wherein, the area of pasting of hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3 is naked electric core 1 by 60 ~ 90% of the area of pasting the face, and is preferred, and the area of pasting of hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3 is naked electric core 1 by 68 ~ 82% of the area of pasting the face. The height that the rubberizing height of hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3 is less than naked electric core 1 in addition, through the processing of punching hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3 for have a plurality of exhaust holes 32 on the hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3.

The hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 comprises a protective layer 33, a first adhesive layer 34, a substrate layer 35 and a second adhesive layer 36 which are sequentially arranged. The protective layer 33 is formed of a styrene-isoprene polymer having a thickness of 2 to 4 μm. The first adhesive layer 34 and the second adhesive layer 36 both use hydrogenated styrene-isoprene polymer as a raw material to form a hydrogenated styrene-isoprene polymer layer, and the thickness of each layer is 10-18 μm. The substrate layer 35 is a common PET layer, and the thickness is 10-15 μm. Wherein, second glue film 36 pastes in advance on naked electric core 1, when treating to become, through control pressure and temperature for protective layer 33 and first glue film 34 dissolve mutually again and paste with casing 2, accomplish pasting of hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3. As shown in fig. 6.

In addition, the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 is further provided with a groove 31, the groove 31 is arranged at one end of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 close to the positive tab 11 and the negative tab 12, and the width of the groove 31 is larger than that of the positive tab 11 and/or the negative tab 12. The width setting of recess 31 is greater than the width of utmost point ear, can make the lower extreme of utmost point ear can hold among recess 31, not only can further increase the rubberizing area and also avoided utmost point ear region simultaneously, avoids hot melt double faced adhesive tape 3 and utmost point ear to overlap and produce the risk that reduces energy density. Wherein, the both ends of the edge of recess 31 can prolong the setting, further increase the rubberizing area. In this embodiment, groove 31 is disposed around positive tab 11 and mates with positive tab 11.

Example 2

The difference from embodiment 1 is the arrangement of the grooves.

As shown in fig. 2, the groove 31 is disposed around the negative tab 12 and matches the negative tab 12.

The rest is the same as embodiment 1, and the description is omitted here.

Example 3

The difference from embodiment 1 is the arrangement of the grooves.

As shown in fig. 3, groove 31 is provided around positive tab 11 and negative tab 12 to surround both positive tab 11 and negative tab 12.

The rest is the same as embodiment 1, and the description is omitted here.

Example 4

The difference from embodiment 1 is the arrangement of the grooves.

As shown in fig. 4, the groove 31 includes a first groove 311 and a second groove 312, the first groove 311 is disposed around the positive tab 11 and matches with the positive tab 11, and the second groove 312 is disposed around the negative tab 12 and matches with the negative tab 12.

The rest is the same as embodiment 1, and the description is omitted here.

Comparative example 1

As shown in fig. 5, a lithium ion battery includes a bare cell 1 formed by a positive electrode with a positive tab 11, an isolation film, and a negative electrode with a negative tab 12 through lamination and/or winding, a casing 2 encapsulating the bare cell 1, and a hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 adhered between the bare cell 1 and the casing 2, wherein the positive tab 11 and the negative tab 12 both extend to the outside of the casing 2, and the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape 3 is provided with two tapes, and the two tapes are adhered to two sides of the bare cell 1 respectively.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses an ingenious structural design increases the bonding area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape, has not only solved large capacity electric core and has leaded to tearing the problem of naked electric core protective layer because of the rubberizing area is little, has solved the problem because of the rubberizing area is big and produce the bubble simultaneously through being provided with a plurality of exhaust holes.

Variations and modifications to the above-described embodiments may become apparent to those skilled in the art from the disclosure and teachings of the above description. Therefore, the present invention is not limited to the above-mentioned embodiments, and any obvious modifications, replacements or variations made by those skilled in the art on the basis of the present invention belong to the protection scope of the present invention. Furthermore, although specific terms are employed herein, they are used in a generic and descriptive sense only and not for purposes of limitation.
